summary: Markets shrugged off Asia's tech rout with a flat-to-firm start, the Nifty edging toward 23,000 as IT stocks rallied while consumer durables and cement slipped.

detail.tone: Better than the pre-open read: instead of a gap-down, the Sensex opened 49 points higher at 74,199.69 and the Nifty at 22,964.50, holding Thursday's gains.
watch: Whether the Nifty can take out 23,000
